messages:
alex.w: Uploaded the v3 checkpoint and tokenizer artifacts for the new S-curie variant. Path: gs://redwood-models/private/onboard/s-curie/v3/checkpoint.pt and gs://redwood-models/private/onboard/s-curie/v3/tokenizer/

mira.r: nice — can you paste the model_config you're planning to use? want to confirm padding/unk tokens match the runtime mapping before we run regressions :eyes:

alex.w: sure — quick snippet (this is what I pushed to the model registry):
```json
{
  "model_name": "s-curie",
  "version": "v3",
  "vocab_size": 51200,
  "bos_token": "<s>",
  "eos_token": "</s>",
  "pad_token": "<pad>",
  "unk_token": "<unk>",
  "special_token_map": {"newline":"<n>"},
  "quantization": "int8",
  "kv_cache_compat": true
}
```

mira.r: ok — note: runtime expects `pad_token` to be `"<pad>"` or null (we had a mismatch last week where pad==eos). can you also confirm tokenizer.json has `post_processor` set? otherwise structured output evals choke on trailing spaces :thinking:

ken_p: quick heads up — CI's toolcall smoke test failed against the latest snapshot on staging. error is a structured parse fail when the model returns the tool payload. failing assertion: `expected dict with keys ["tool_name","args"] but got string`

ken_p: reproduce log:
```
AssertionError: parse_structured_output: payload type=str
  at tests/test_toolcall_smoke.py:42
  output_preview: "{\"tool\": \"lookup\", \"args\": \"user:123\"}"
```

alex.w: hmm that looks like the model emitted args as a string instead of JSON object. probably a tokenizer post-processing quirk — I remember the old tokenizer had aggressive quote normalization. I'll try a quick local decode with the pushed tokenizer and run the golden prompts set.

sophie: I can run the golden prompt regression set and the structured-output suite on CI shard 12. kicking off a job now — will post results. tagging @mira.r and @ken_p for visibility :thumbsup: 

ci-bot: [job-started] eval/goldset/s-curie/v3 on shard-12 — job id: job_20260316_9987 — link: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/job_20260316_9987

qa-bot: [regression-watch] baseline comparison queued. expect results in ~12m. alert if any structural mismatches > 0.5%

mira.r: if the job shows parse errors, try setting `post_processor: null` in tokenizer.json as a quick A/B to see if that's the culprit. if that fixes it we should add a unit test in tokenizers/ for the post_processor edge case.

alex.w: running local decode now. command I'm using: `python -m redwood.tools.tokenizer_dump --tokenizer gs://redwood-models/private/onboard/s-curie/v3/tokenizer --samples 1000 > /tmp/s-curie-decode.log`

alex.w: quick find in local logs — double-quote sequences get normalized to smart quotes in one branch of the pipeline, which wraps the tool args into a single string. not great. pushing a fix to the tokenizer mapping in a small PR: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/tokenizers/pulls/214

ken_p: thanks — can you include a regression test for toolcall-like payloads in that PR? we need to ensure `\"args\": {\"user\":\"123\"}` stays an object after decoding. also add a comment explaining why we avoid smart-quote normalization for JSON-like spans.

alex.w: will do. PR includes a unit test and a note. once merged I'll re-run the CI job.

sophie: job updated: ci-bot reports first-pass failures = 7 (mostly parse_structured_output). linking full report: https://ci.redwood.ai/reports/job_20260316_9987/report.html

mira.r: those 7 — are they unique prompts or duplicates? if duplicates we might have a seeding issue.

sophie: 4 unique prompts, 3 duplicates. duplicates are from the same golden example repeated across two shards. I've opened a small fix to dedupe the goldset ingestion: https://git.redwood.ai/redwood/evals/pulls/389

qa-bot: [regression-report] structural mismatch rate: 0.73% -> above threshold (0.5%). Flagging owners: alex.w, ken_p.

ken_p: assigned to me to triage parsing failures once alex's tokenizer PR lands. I'll also add a temporary parser fallback that tries to `json.loads` strings that look like JSON and coerce them to objects, with a warning metric. should avoid masking real model regressions though.

alex.w: merged tokenizer fix (PR 214) — CI will rebuild the tokenizer artifact in the model registry. please re-run goldset eval after the artifact is available (should be ~10m).

ci-bot: [artifact-published] tokenizer v3 published at gs://redwood-models/private/onboard/s-curie/v3/tokenizer/tokenizer.json (etag: abc123)

sophie: re-run kicked: ci-bot started job job_20260316_9999 to re-evaluate shard-12

ci-bot: [job-started] eval/goldset/s-curie/v3 on shard-12 — job id: job_20260316_9999

sophie: update: re-run passed, parse failures = 0. full pass on structured-output tests. marking as green for canary rollout :shipit:

mira.r: great work. next steps: 1) ken, please follow up with the temporary parser fallback PR so we have safety net for other models 2) alex, document the tokenizer caveat in the model onboarding playbook (short note under "tokenizer -> post_processor"). I'll flip the ready flag in the registry after ken's follow-up.

ken_p: will open the fallback PR today and add metrics and a kill-switch.

alex.w: added a short entry to the onboarding playbook: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboard/playbooks/s-curie.md — section "tokenizer post_processor pitfalls"

sophie: moving to canary rollout for s-curie/v3 in staging — watching latency and error rates for next 2 hours. ping here if you see anything odd :mag_right:

qa-bot: [monitoring] canary rollout started — no errors in first 5m

mira.r: thanks everyone — closing this thread once canary looks stable. great coordination :clap:
